summary: Reference findings: every planted defect, cited at its line.

findings.claim: Money is accumulated as float dollars and truncated with int(); cents drift.
Intent is created and confirmed before the sale is persisted; a crash between confirm and save orphans an authorized charge.
Raw card token is written to the log.
Any existing intent id, including a canceled one, blocks a new card attempt and locks the cashier out.
findings.evidence: if sale.intent_id is not None: raise

findings.claim: Lines are cleared without a snapshot; after a crash the sale is an empty cart.
Cash checkout does not cancel a pending card authorization; double charge.
Recovery raises on stock shortfall before releasing the authorization; the card hold is stranded.
Any GatewayError is reported as not_found, so a transport error is treated as no money taken.
Webhook replay decrements stock again; seen_events is written but never checked.
Refund amount is not bounded by captured minus refunded.
